questions.prompt: What is the name of the galaxy we live in?

questions.prompt: Mercury has no moons.

questions.explain: Ursa Major means 'Great Bear'.

questions.explain: Neptune's winds are the fastest recorded on any planet.

questions.prompt: How many bones are there in a typical adult human body?
